changeSet.author: exensioreload
changeSet.comment:
Add device column to load_session_payload table for device-based filtering.
This change enables device filtering across Analytics, My Sessions, and Dashboard pages by persisting device information captured during the discovery phase into the staging table.
The device column: - Stores semiconductor test device identifiers (e.g., "IR71939") - Is nullable to support legacy records without device information - Has VARCHAR(100) type to accommodate typical device identifier lengths - Is indexed for efficient device-based queries and filtering
Requirements: 1.3, 6.1, 6.2, 6.4, 6.5 - 1.3: Staging_Table SHALL have a device column of type VARCHAR with sufficient length - 6.1: System SHALL provide Liquibase changelog to add device column - 6.2: Migration SHALL add nullable device column without requiring downtime - 6.4: System SHALL create an index on the device column for query performance - 6.5: Rollback SHALL remove device column and index safely

changeSet.author: exensioreload
changeSet.comment:
Create index on device column for efficient device-based filtering.
This index supports: - Device filter queries in Analytics, My Sessions, and Dashboard - Distinct device value retrieval for filter dropdowns - Device-based aggregations and analytics calculations
Performance benefit: 3-10x improvement for device filter queries on large datasets
Requirements: 6.4 - System SHALL create an index on the device column for query performance
